_note: Model shape needed to compute KV-cache arithmetic without loading anything. Numbers below are the published Qwen2.5-3B layout; kv_per_token is derived, not copied.

qwen2.5-3b.name: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct
qwen2.5-3b.source: Qwen2.5-3B config.json (num_hidden_layers 36, num_attention_heads 16, num_key_value_heads 2, head_dim 128); weights = measured 1.81 GiB for Q4_K_M on this box

_kv_note: kv_bytes_per_token = 2 (K and V) x n_kv_heads x head_dim x n_layers x dtype_bytes. For qwen2.5-3b in fp16: 2 x 2 x 128 x 36 x 2 = 36864 B = 36 KiB/token. Cross-checked against vLLM's own allocation on this card: 0.22 GiB / 401 blocks = 0.5625 MiB per 16-token block, i.e. exactly 16 x 36864 B.
